description: This is a Go source file defining the 'server' package for the focalboard project. It includes the Server struct, initialization, start, shutdown, and configuration methods, as well as dependencies on various services and external packages.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Represents the main server component managing web, websocket, telemetry, metrics, and session cleanup services.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new Server instance with configured services, API routes, and telemetry.

methods.name: NewStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SQL store connection based on configuration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the web server, local mode server if enabled, session cleanup, metrics updates, and telemetry jobs.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the server, stopping services, closing connections, and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: UpdateAppConfig
methods.description: Updates the app with the current server configuration.

methods.name: startLocalModeServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts a local Unix socket server for local API access.

methods.name: stopLocalModeServer
methods.description: Stops the local Unix socket server if running.

methods.name: GetRootRouter
methods.description: Returns the main router for the web server.
